:::{#hero-heading}
<center>**Bed Market** is an indie rock band from Lyon, France. We released our first album '**Last Call for First Impression**' in 2025 as a way of saying goodbye to all the moments we spent together making these songs.</center>

<center>Do not hesitate to have a listen through the **player I've coded on the right** or to check our **music videos below**. Enjoy!<br><br></center>
:::
